answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the marble funding graph is rebuilt from the knoll history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 40 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 40 bonds yet holds one position, and the prism report publishes the merged exposure. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
